div.head: II Cn 2
div.ab: And we lærað, þæt, þeah hwa agylte ⁊ hine sylfne deope forwyrce, þonne gefadige man steore, swa hit for Gode sy gebeorhlic ⁊ for worulde aberendlic.
And we lærað, þæt, ðeah hwa agylte ⁊ hine sylfne deope forwyrce, þonne gefadige man þa steoræ, swa hit for Gode sy gebeorhlic ⁊ for werulde ab[e]rendlic.
And witena gerædnes is, þæt þeah hwa agilte ⁊ hine silfne deope forwyrce, þonne medemige man þa stéore, swa hit for Gode sy gebeorhlic ⁊ for worlde aberendlic.
Si quis peccauerit et se ipsum profunde forisfaciat, temperetur in eo iusticia, sicut erga Deum sit clementius et in seculo tolerabilius.
⁊ we lærað þæt, þeah hwa agylte ⁊ hine sylfne deope forwyrce, ðonne gefadie man ða steore, swa hit for Gode sy gebeorhlic ⁊ for worulde aberendlic.
And we lærað þæt þeah hwa agylte and hine sylfne deope forwyrce, þonne gefadige man ða steore swa hit for Gode sy gebeorhlic and for worulde aberendlic.
And we enjoin that, even if anyone sins and commits grievous crime, the punishment shall be ordered as shall be justifiable in the sight of God and acceptable in the eyes of men.
And we instruct that even if someone sins and dishonors himself entirely, the penalty shall be assessed in such a way as shall be justifiable before God and acceptable to the community.

Und wir ermahnen (Beschluss der Witan ist D), dass, wenngleich einer sündigt und sich (sein Leben) schwer verwirkt, dann regele (ermässige D) man die Strafe, wie es sich vor Gott verantworten und im Staat ertragen lässt.

And we instruct (it is the decision of the witan, D) that, even if someone sins and forfeits himself deeply, the punishment be so ordered (moderated, D) as can be justified before God and tolerated in the world.
